text: So i was thinking what we do is we split the skybox into 2 sections one half of it is going to be the coast where u can see in the distance another city. this one they get notoriety for and will just get blasted. no need for a invis wall. if they make it. we give them an achievement. then we attach the procedural city to the roads at the other end of the map that go off into just the same fucking thing over and over and silently dont tell the player. they dont gain notoriety for it. they just at some point discover they are driving fucking nowhere
resolution: Resolved the boundary design into a two-section skybox, both fed by ONE procedural generator, opposite emotional beats. COAST half: another city across a water gap; notoriety climbs and the player gets blasted (no invisible wall); survive the crossing => achievement, implemented as a one-shot story flag (game/story/ setFlag — no new achievement system needed). ROAD half: authored roads seam contiguously into procedural chunks at the map edge; NO notoriety, NO trigger, silent; the player emergently discovers they're 'driving nowhere' as sameness repeats forever. Two diegetic boundaries, zero invisible walls — punishment vs silence as the two teaching signals. No code; design settled.
